  radarr:
    - name: Radarr
      url: http://radarr.media.svc.cluster.local:7878
      access_url: https://radarr.clerici.tech
      apikey: $${RADARR_API_KEY}
    - name: Radarr (raphael)
      url: http://radarr-raphael.media.svc.cluster.local:7878
      access_url: https://radarr-raphael.clerici.tech
      apikey: $${RADARR_RAPHAEL_API_KEY}
  prowlarr:
    - name: Prowlarr
      url: http://prowlarr.media.svc.cluster.local:9696
      access_url: https://prowlarr.clerici.tech
      apikey: $${PROWLARR_API_KEY}
  bazarr:
    - name: Bazarr
      url: http://bazarr.media.svc.cluster.local:6767
      access_url: https://bazarr.clerici.tech
      apikey: $${BAZARR_API_KEY}
  jellyfin:

      access_url: https://jellyfin.clerici.tech
      apikey: $${JELLYFIN_API_KEY}
  overseerr:

      access_url: https://seerr.clerici.tech
      apikey: $${SEERR_API_KEY}
  # No qbittorrent type upstream
  general:
    - name: qBittorrent
      url: http://qbittorrent.qbittorrent.svc.cluster.local:8080/api/v2/transfer/info
      access_url: https://qbit.clerici.tech
for i in $(seq 1 60); do ot-ctl txpower 20 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; exit 0
for i in $(seq 1 60); do ot-ctl txpower 20 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; exit 0

url: https://s3.clerici.tech/_/health
conditions:
  - "[STATUS] == 200"
  - "[CERTIFICATE_EXPIRATION] > 240h"
client:
  dns-resolver: udp://${K8S_GATEWAY_CLUSTER_IP}:53

modules:
  http_2xx:
    prober: http
    timeout: 5s
    http:
      valid_http_versions: ["HTTP/1.1", "HTTP/2.0"]
      follow_redirects: true
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
  icmp:
    prober: icmp
    timeout: 5s
    icmp:
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
  tcp_connect:
    prober: tcp
    timeout: 5s
    tcp:
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
  dns_udp:
    prober: dns
    timeout: 5s
    dns:
      query_name: "google.com"
      query_type: "A"
      transport_protocol: udp
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
